# `m.partners.etf_global.taxonomies`

<!-- Generated by `uv run python scripts/render_reference.py`; do not edit by hand. -->

ETF Global's classification of US-listed ETFs by strategy, structure, and exposure.

```python
m.partners.etf_global.taxonomies(symbols=None, *, sort=None, order=None, limit=None, filters=None)
```

[All datasets](README.md)

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| Verbs | `fetch()`, `poll()` |
| Served by | REST |
| `poll()` | `dm.PollMode.REPLACE`: holds exactly the latest cycle's rows, keyed by `Symbol`, `EffectiveDate` and `ProcessedDate` |
| `sort` | any REST field of the rows (see Massive fields below), or several separated by commas, each with an optional `.asc` or `.desc` |
| `filters` | `composite_ticker_gt`, `composite_ticker_gte`, `composite_ticker_lt`, `composite_ticker_lte`, `effective_date`, `effective_date_gt`, `effective_date_gte`, `effective_date_lt`, `effective_date_lte`, `processed_date`, `processed_date_gt`, `processed_date_gte`, `processed_date_lt`, `processed_date_lte` |

## Columns

| Column | Deephaven type | Description | Supplied by |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Symbol` | String | The instrument, in the library's canonical symbol form. From REST `composite_ticker`: "The stock ticker symbol used to identify this ETF product on exchanges." | REST |
| `RawSymbol` | String | The symbol exactly as Massive sent it, on a row whose spelling the library cannot read as the dataset's class (its `Symbol` is then null); null on every other row. Present unless the session's `unreadable_symbols` is `dm.OnError.RAISE`, which fails on such a row instead. | REST |
| `AssetClass` | String | The primary type of assets held by the ETF, such as equities, bonds, commodities, or other securities. | REST |
| `Category` | String | The broad investment category that describes the ETF's investment focus and strategy. | REST |
| `Country` | String | The specific country focus of the ETF, if applicable. | REST |
| `CreditQualityRating` | String | Credit quality rating for fixed income ETFs. | REST |
| `Description` | String | The official name and description of the ETF product. | REST |
| `DevelopmentClass` | String | The economic development classification of the markets the ETF invests in, such as developed, emerging, or frontier markets. | REST |
| `Duration` | String | The duration characteristics for fixed income ETFs. | REST |
| `EffectiveDate` | String | The date showing when the information was accurate or valid; some issuers, such as Vanguard, release their data on a delay, so the effective_date can be several weeks earlier than the processed_date. | REST |
| `Esg` | String | Environmental, Social, and Governance characteristics. | REST |
| `ExposureMechanism` | String | The mechanism used to achieve exposure. | REST |
| `Factor` | String | Factor exposure characteristics of the ETF. | REST |
| `Focus` | String | The specific investment focus or exposure that the ETF provides, such as sector, geography, or investment style. | REST |
| `HedgeReset` | String | The frequency of hedge reset, if applicable. | REST |
| `HoldingsDisclosureFrequency` | String | How frequently holdings are disclosed. | REST |
| `InceptionDate` | String | The date when this ETF was first launched and became available for trading. | REST |
| `Isin` | String | The International Securities Identification Number, a global standard code for uniquely identifying this ETF worldwide. | REST |
| `Issuer` | String | The financial institution or fund company that created and sponsors this ETF. | REST |
| `LeverageReset` | String | The frequency of leverage reset, if applicable. | REST |
| `LeverageStyle` | String | Indicates whether the ETF uses leverage to amplify returns ('leveraged'), or does not use leverage ('unleveraged'). | REST |
| `LeveredAmount` | double | The leverage multiplier applied by the ETF, where positive numbers indicate leveraged exposure and negative numbers indicate inverse exposure. | REST |
| `ManagementClassification` | String | Defines whether an ETF is considered active under SEC rules, with managers making investment decisions, or passive, tracking an index. | REST |
| `ManagementStyle` | String | Indicates whether an ETF is managed actively or passively, and the level of transparency or replication method used. | REST |
| `Maturity` | String | The maturity profile for fixed income ETFs. | REST |
| `Objective` | String | The primary investment objective of the ETF. | REST |
| `PrimaryBenchmark` | String | The main index or benchmark that this ETF is designed to track or replicate. | REST |
| `ProcessedDate` | String | The date showing when ETF Global received and processed the data. | REST |
| `ProductType` | String | Indicates whether the product is an Exchange-Traded Note ('etn') or an Exchange-Traded Fund ('etf'). | REST |
| `RebalanceFrequency` | String | How frequently the ETF rebalances its holdings. | REST |
| `ReconstitutionFrequency` | String | How frequently the index is reconstituted. | REST |
| `Region` | String | The geographic region or area of the world where the ETF concentrates its investments. | REST |
| `SecondaryObjective` | String | The secondary investment objective, if applicable. | REST |
| `SelectionMethodology` | String | The methodology used to select securities. | REST |
| `SelectionUniverse` | String | The universe from which securities are selected. | REST |
| `StrategicFocus` | String | The strategic investment focus of the ETF. | REST |
| `TargetedFocus` | String | The targeted investment focus of the ETF. | REST |
| `TaxClassification` | String | The tax structure of the ETF, determining whether investors receive 1099 or K1 tax forms (RIC, Partnership, or UIT). | REST |
| `UsCode` | String | A unique identifier code that identifies this ETF in US markets. | REST |
| `WeightingMethodology` | String | The methodology used to weight holdings. | REST |
| `TimestampInsert` | Instant | When the library received the row, as an Instant: the local clock when the REST page, flat-file block, or WebSocket frame that carried it arrived, the same for every row of one. It is not monotonic and is not Massive's own receive time; on history() rows it is the download time, and in a poll() table the latest poll's. | REST |
